messages:
Maya (AE): Borealis Health sent an LOI asking for a 36% off list on a 2yr Dedicated + Private deployment. They also want a 120-day free trial credit and expedited onboarding (onsite kick-off). Security asks: SOC2 + HIPAA attestation, BYO-HSM, IdP with SAML + SCIM. They want annual invoicing upfront. Need deal-desk signoff to include this in the quote.
Ethan (Deal Desk): 36% is outside our standard playbook. Can you share expected committed spend and ARR-equivalent? Also, are partner/referral credits in play?
Maya (AE): Commit = $4.5M ARR-equivalent over 2yrs (~$9M list). Year1 usage skewed to pilot at 40% then full prod. They flagged procurement prefers annual upfront payments.
Priya (SE): Tech check: to hit their SLA target (p95 <150ms at 5k concurrent gen qps) we should reserve a dedicated high-priority pool and enable aggressive KV caching. That adds a ~10% infra uplift. BYO-HSM via KMS integration is OK but needs an ops window and KMS cert exchange.
Sam (Finance): If they pay annually upfront we get better cash flow; however, we can't give 36% without reducing payment term friction. Quick math: 36% off on $9M list = $5.76M net. COGS estimate for Dedicated+Private+trial = ~$2.1M across term. Margin ~ 63% pre-support. But the upfront payment reduces financing risk.
Ivy (CSM): Onboarding ask is hefty. Onsite kick-off + 120-day white-glove support would require 2x CS lead allocation for first 3 months. Need to decide if services are included or billable. Recommend SOW.
Nora (Legal): We need to limit the "free trial credit" definition: either token-based or compute-hour cap. Also HIPAA language and Business Associate Agreement (BAA) must be added. Annual upfront changes our standard billing terms; Legal will review changes.
Ethan (Deal Desk): Proposal: Approve up to 25% off list for standard enterprise commit with annual upfront, plus a trial credit cap of $100k. Any deeper discount (>=30%) requires VP Sales + CRO. Also exclude professional services and onboarding SOW from discount. Include infra uplift as a separate charge.
Maya (AE): Could we do a blended approach: 30% on core platform, additional 6% rebate paid quarterly upon usage gates being met? That preserves margin and ties deeper discount to attainment.
Sam (Finance): Blended / earned rebate is preferable. Recommend: 27% up-front discount + up-to-9% earnback tied to quarterly usage thresholds (over 24 months), capped at $150k for trial. Annual upfront invoice required.
Priya (SE): Practically, earned rebate tied to usage is fine, but we need service-level gates in the contract to protect capacity. Also request a maintenance blackout window agreement for the private deployment.
pricing-bot: automated-check: floor_discount = 18%, deal_desk_threshold = 25%, vp_sales_threshold = 30%, cro_threshold = 35%. Trial_credit_recommendation = 100000.
Ethan (Deal Desk): I'm comfortable approving 25% immediately. For Maya's blended structure, escalate to VP Sales for sign-off on the earned-rebate schedule. I'll record a provisional approval: 25% + $100k trial cap + infra uplift excluded.
Nora (Legal): If VP Sales approves the earned rebate, Legal will draft appropriate clawback language and define the trial credit metrics. BAA + HIPAA addendum required before signature.
Ivy (CSM): I'll draft an SOW for onboarding that can be offered as billable or credited against the trial cap. Will queue resource availability for the proposed kickoff windows.
Maya (AE): Thanks. I'll present: 25% firm discount with option for a performance-based rebate up to additional 9% (requires VP Sales) and a $100k max trial credit, annual upfront invoicing, exclude services from discount, infra uplift line item. I'll loop VP Sales and share customer response here.
Ethan (Deal Desk): Noted. If VP Sales vibes it, we'll route to CRO only if they push past 35% total. Otherwise we keep it in Deal Desk/VPS loop.
Maya (AE): Sending proposal now. Will update thread with counter or acceptance.
